P1: The search was requested for 30 days but only evaluated for the last 12 days (status partial). The 120 refunds all went to cards from one country, but that covers only 12 days. Refunds to other countries in days 13–30 are unchecked, so we can't say there were none. Cannot tell.

P2: The link took effect at 09:40 Monday, but it was learned at 15:00 Monday, after the 10:00 scoring. The evidence was not available to the check at scoring time, so it did not miss available evidence. Answer: No.

P3: The refund rate rose from 1% to 6%, a sixfold increase, in a week. Whether that warrants review is a judgment call, but a sixfold jump in refunds is a reasonable trigger for review, especially given the question being asked. Yes.

RESULT PN-008 | P1: Cannot tell | P2: No | P3: Yes
